name: Nahallal
overview: Nahallal, also known as Nahalal or Nahalol, is identified in Scripture as a Levitical city, emphasizing its role in the distribution of land to the Levites (Joshua 21:35). It is listed among the towns allotted to the tribe of Zebulun (Joshua 19:15), highlighting its geographical and tribal significance. However, Judges 1:30 records that the inhabitants of Nahalol were not fully driven out by Zebulun, allowing Canaanites to remain and become tributaries, which reflects the incomplete conquest of the Promised Land in that region.
